# TDK ICM45686 basic driver subset

Source: https://github.com/tdk-invn-oss/motion.arduino.ICM45686
Commit: `9abfe2e112f0d219c293e8960e76ece882bbaebf`

The eight files in `imu/` are copied unchanged from upstream `src/imu/`.
The upstream root LICENSE and source-file copyright/license notices are retained.
Arduino, APEX and advanced/FIFO implementations are not included.
Linux transport and commissioning code lives separately in `native/icm45686/`.
